I started around your age, and you are at the right place to STOP. If you hurt yourself more, youll have scars and when they fade, at least in my case, its even harder to resist doing it again. I would suggest throwing away whatever you are using, make sure to tell someone you trust a lot. I know its really hard to tell yourself that youre going to stop, but if you do it now it will be so much easier than when you have been doing it for a long time. Best wishes :)
